news.title: Cornyn meeting with Blanche canceled ahead of key Judiciary Committee vote
news.summary: Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas) on Wednesday said his scheduled meeting with attorney general nominee Todd Blanche was canceled and that he’s “not prepared to vote yes” on advancing Blanche out of the Judiciary Committee Thursday.
